items.name: CubeCo Coastal Cubing KZN 2025
items.information:
**Durban’s First 2-Day Cubing Competition in Over Two Years!**

Join us for an action-packed weekend of speedcubing on March 21st & 22nd!

Day 1 (Friday) falls on Human Rights Day, making it the perfect opportunity to challenge yourself with events you don't always see - like Clock, Megaminx, and even 3x3 Blindfolded! If you're looking to try something new, this is your chance.

Day 2 (Saturday) is all about the fan favorites: Pyraminx, 2x2, and a full three rounds of 3x3. Whether you're a seasoned competitor or brand new to WCA events, there's something for you.

New to competing? No problem! We'll have a newcomer tutorial to walk you through competing and judging (yes, even first-timers help with judging). Just remember to bring a form of ID for registration. While most beginner-friendly events happen on Saturday, you're absolutely welcome to compete on Friday too!

Don't miss out - come test your skills, meet fellow cubers, and be part of Durban's cubing community!

​

items.information:
This Fewest Moves competition is part of CubingZA's South African National Championship for 2023, but is being hosted in three separate venues across the nation, namely Cape Town, Johannesburg, and Durban.

Please note that only the 3x3x3 Fewest Moves will be held officially - this is not an ideal competition for newcomers or those who only know speedsolving. Fewest Moves is comprised of 3 separate 1-hour attempts to solve the cube in the lowest possible number of moves. By WCA regulations, the puzzle must be solved in 80 moves or less in order to be a valid attempt, otherwise the result will be DNF. If you cannot solve the puzzle in 80 moves or less, please consider not registering for this event.

In between each attempt to break up the day will be breaks where we may compete in some unofficial relay events, like 3BLD relays, Guildford or Mini-guildford challenges, team-solving, or 2x2-7x7 relays. More information will be released about these closer to the competition.

**GUESTS**

Please note that guests and spectators are NOT welcome at this competition, unless special arrangements have been made prior to the event with the competition organisers (for example, for younger competitors that require a parent or guardian present). The venues are small and there must be absolute silence for the duration of each attempt.

Competitors who register on the WCA website at least 14 days before the competition will be granted free access to the expo and will only have to pay the competition entry fee. If you would like to volunteer to help staff at the competition, please contact one of the WCA delegates. Please state which dates and times you will be available. Volunteer schedules will be drawn up so that they don't clash with your competing.
